children: U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth said on social media that if Iran fires on U.S. ships, the United States will destroy and sink its tankers. According to Sina Finance, he also said Iran's tanker fleet is defenseless and that Iran has neither a navy nor an air force, while U.S. aircraft, ships, and submarines could wipe them out.

title: US Defense Secretary Hegseth: Iran Tankers Would Be Sunk If U.S. Ships Are Attacked
